title: A batch SLO counts deadline outcomes
method: Synthetic 500-report window: good=475/500=95%. At 98% objective, bad allowance=(1−0.98)×500=10; actual bad=20+5=25, exceeding by 15. Deadline and content criteria are explicit.
alt: A batch SLO counts deadline outcomes: On time and correct 475 reports, Late 20 reports, Failed 5 reports. Synthetic example.
